messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: SableBank (dedicated pool us-west-2) — 'trace ingestion nullpoints' reported. Paging oncall-sre. Severity: P2. Automated impact check: traces missing for tenant sablebank-01, metrics delayed.

sam-oc: ack. I’m on it. :mag_right: Starting triage — grabbing forwarder and collector logs.

lina-sre: I see a spike in ingest errors from forwarder group fw-usw2-*. Errors look like 403 from trace-collector with message 'tenant auth missing' for tracer IDs. Logs still flow (app logs + metrics) but span ingestion attempts return 403/empty response.

mira-se: SableBank confirms they are seeing no traces in our Console for the last ~35m, but their requests are hitting the model endpoints and embeddings are fine. They rely on traces for billing/debugging.

ops-bot: note: pager routed to infra-team, added #infra-oncall. Escalation path: sam-oc -> lina-sre -> ken-runtime.

sam-oc: first quick checks: forwarding token service reports 200, but token issuance for tenant sablebank-01 returns a 204 body-empty when requested by the forwarder. Trying a manual token refresh.

lina-sre: timeline: around 15:14 UTC we rotated a short-lived signer key in the forwarder auth cluster. There was a rollout of the auth-proxy to fw-usw2 yesterday; maybe older forwarders didn't pick up the new key.

ken-runtime: Confirmed. Auth-proxy log shows: `WARN tenant_lookup: token_not_found for tenant=sablebank-01` at 15:14:33. Forwarder attempted 3 retries then moved to 429/backoff.

mira-se: SableBank asks if this is user-visible: are production requests failing?

lina-sre: Quick customer impact summary: model inference requests are succeeding. Only trace ingestion and some trace-linked metrics ingestion are affected for that tenant. No request/latency SLOs broken, but debugging and tracing features in Console show gaps.

sam-oc: Mitigation plan (live): 1) Re-issue tenant-sablebank service token from admin console with a forced new key. 2) Trigger forwarder to re-fetch tokens (curl to /internal/reload-auth on fw-usw2 group). 3) If that fails, failover trace ingestion for that tenant to central-collector fallback (read-only) to resume span visibility.

lina-sre: Executing step 1 now. Ran: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/tenants/sablebank-01/refresh-token" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API" -d '{"force":true}'
```
Response: 200, new token created.

sam-oc: Step 2: hitting forwarder: ```bash
for pod in $(kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=fw-usw2 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'); do
  kubectl -n infra exec $pod -- curl -sS -X POST localhost:8080/internal/reload-auth || echo "$pod reload failed"
done
```
feedback: 2/3 pods reloaded successfully, 1 pod returns connection refused.

ken-runtime: That 1 pod is crashlooping on startup due to a config mount error (weird). I'm kicking it to replace now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/fw-usw2` — monitoring.

ops-bot: update: infra rotation started, slack alert pinned.

mira-se: any way to reduce customer impact while we replace pods? Can we route SableBank traffic to other forwarders?

lina-sre: Yes — we can update tenant routing to point sablebank-01 -> central-fallback-forwarder for traces only. This is a hot config change but low risk (read path). Doing it now via internal-config API.

lina-sre: command: ```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://config.internal/api/tenant-routing/sablebank-01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"trace_forwarder":"central-collector-fallback","metrics_mode":"best-effort"}'
```
Response: 202 accepted.

sam-oc: After routing change, I see collector ingestion rate for sablebank-01 jump from 0 to ~12 spans/s. Console traces appear backfilled slowly. :tada:

mira-se: SableBank confirms traces returning in their Console view. They're asking for root cause and ETA for permanent fix.

lina-sre: Root cause (initial): forwarder auth-proxy key rotation + one forwarder pod failing to pick up new config -> partial auth failures for tenant tokens. Fix path: replace offending pod (already triggered), push a fix to the config-mount job to make it robust, and add a safety: forwarders should fallback to cached tenant tokens for 5m if auth-proxy returns unexpected response.

ken-runtime: I'll follow up with a small patch: add caching + better retry handling. Opening PR and will run canary in staging, targeting a hotfix deploy in next 6 hours if tests pass.

sam-oc: Temporary follow-ups for oncall: 1) Keep routing sablebank-01 to central-fallback for traces until deploy is validated. 2) Monitor trace ingestion rates and Console backfill progress. 3) Postmortem to include why config mount broke on that pod.

ops-bot: note: paging cleared (customer-visible impact reduced). Oncall handoff scheduled in 45m to lina-sre -> ken-runtime for follow-through.

mira-se: I'll message SableBank with context: explain that inference not impacted, tracing resumed via fallback, and we have a PR and timeline for permanent fix. Will include runbook steps and timeline.

lina-sre: Adding action items: [ ] postmortem draft (assigned lina-sre) [ ] PR for caching + retry (assigned ken-runtime) [ ] customer communication (assigned mira-se) [ ] validate config-mount fix in infra images (assigned sam-oc).

sam-oc: any other tenants showing similar auth gaps? Quick grep shows a few 403 spikes but only sablebank-01 sustained gap; others auto-recovered when forwarder pods reloaded.

mira-se: thanks team. SableBank says they are unblocked for immediate work. Please keep me posted; I'll coordinate the customer update.

lina-sre: marking thread resolved for live mitigation. Will keep it open for the postmortem items until closed.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS CHANGE: severity -> P3 (mitigated); responders: sam-oc, lina-sre, ken-runtime, mira-se.

ops-bot: final: handoff note pinned to thread.
